notes: SHAPE: src/Catalog.php's constants are NOT turned into translation keys. Two other extensions read those constants directly and looksmax-userinfo/src/RankSource.php:106,121 resolves its lookup by MATCHING ON THE name VALUE (mb_strtolower($r['name']) === $key) - a key in that column breaks it silently, and looksmax-store/src/Seed.php:189-223 seeds name/blurb from those constants into store_items, so keys there would be written into the database. Instead a single private Catalog::localize() derives the key from each row's slug and every lookup method runs its result through it. Net effect: the store, the profile, the hovercard and the DOM decorator all get translated text without any file outside this extension changing, and a missing key falls back to the English literal rather than to a raw `local-...` string.
Apply the Catalog.php replacements in the order given: cat-01 inserts the helpers that every other replacement calls.

js/dist/forum.js is a standalone IIFE injected by src/InjectIdentity.php as its own <script>. It holds no `app` binding, so the JS replacements go through window.lmxI18n.t(), which boots `app` lazily, records misses for the i18n gate, and takes the English text as a fallback. js-01 adds the local `t()` wrapper that the rest use and must be applied first.

deferred.reason: NOT a string to translate — a correctness hazard this spec creates. Once idc-04 lands, /api/identity/names carries LOCALISED rank and tier names and is still served `Cache-Control: public, max-age=60` with no Vary. A shared cache in front of PHP would hand a Spanish reader the English payload for up to a minute. There is no shared cache in this stack today (nginx.conf proxies /api straight through), so it is latent, not live. Fix is one line — add `'Vary' => 'Accept-Language, Cookie'` to that header array, or drop `public` — but it is a caching-policy change, not a translation, so it belongs to whoever owns the HTTP layer.

Deliberately NOT translated and deliberately NOT broken. These read Catalog::RANKS / Catalog::BADGES directly rather than through the localised lookups, so they keep printing the English literal. An operator's console output should not follow the forum's default locale, and keeping the constants literal is what makes that free.
Checked: the only `content:` rules in all three files are `justify-content` matches (forum.less:125, :315, :431). No text is generated from CSS in this extension, so there is nothing to move into JS.

OUTSIDE MY BOUNDARY, and the reason this spec does not put keys in the Catalog constants. RankSource resolves a user's request by lowercasing Catalog::RANKS/STYLES `name` values and comparing. It reads the constants, not the lookups, so it is unaffected by everything above and keeps matching English. If that lane wants `/rank oro` to work in Spanish it must match on `slug` as well as `name`; that is a two-line change in their file and I have not touched it.

OUTSIDE MY BOUNDARY. Seed.php copies Catalog names and blurbs into the store_items TABLE at seed time, so store rows freeze whatever locale the seeder ran in. It reads the constants directly, so after this spec it keeps seeding English — correct, not broken, but it means the store's own item copy is a database concern the store lane owns, not something this locale pack can reach. It also concatenates the three headline lines with '. ', which is an English list join.

IN my boundary but correctly left alone. This is the fallback ladder used only when looksmax-ranks is absent, and nothing reads its `name`: Ledger::refreshRank() and every caller take ['slug']. Verified by grep — there is no reader of a name from Ledger::ranks()/rankFor() anywhere in extensions/. Translating it would add 20 keys nobody can ever read.
